$comment: Models to compare. apiKeyEnv is the NAME of the env var holding the key, never the key. Prices are US dollars per million tokens. 'verified: false' means the id or price could not be checked against the provider's own docs when this file was written (see eval/README.md); run `npm run eval:models -- --list-models` to see which ids your account actually has. A model whose id isn't on the account, or whose key env var isn't set, is skipped with a message.

models.label: groq-gpt-oss-120b
models.priceSource: https://groq.com/pricing (not reachable from the session that wrote this; figure from https://www.usagepricing.com/blueprint/groq, which cites Groq's model docs captured 24 Oct 2026)
models.why: The live model today (AI_CHAT_MODEL default on Groq). The baseline every other model is compared with.

models.label: groq-gpt-oss-20b
models.priceSource: https://groq.com/pricing (not reachable from the session that wrote this; figure from https://costbench.com/software/llm-api-providers/groq/ and https://www.maximem.ai/blog/groq-api-pricing-2026)
models.why: The same family as the baseline at half the price and faster. Tells us whether the cheaper sibling reads jobs well enough; it is also the most likely replacement if the 120b is retired.

models.label: groq-kimi-k2
models.priceSource: https://groq.com/pricing (not reachable from the session that wrote this; figure from https://costbench.com/software/llm-api-providers/groq/; newer third-party lists don't mention it, so it may have been retired)
models.why: A large non-reasoning model from a different family: a check on whether a bigger model reads mixed-trade and vague jobs better, at about 6x the baseline's cost.

models.label: anthropic-claude-haiku
